Here is a precise, element-by-element description of the image:

**Overall Layout & Containers**
The image displays a vertical stack of three rounded rectangular cards (panels) set against a light gray background. Each card has a white fill and a subtle light gray border.

**Top Card (Partially Visible)**
*   **Text:** Contains the fragment "their timestamps." in a dark gray sans-serif font, left-aligned near the top of the visible area.

**Middle Card: "Resample (thin)"**
*   **Header Text:** The bold, black text **"Resample (thin)"** appears at the top-left inside the card.
*   **Body Text:** Below the header is the sentence: "Thin an over-dense recording to a minimum spacing between kept points." in dark gray text.
*   **Spacing:** There is clear vertical separation between the header and the body text; they do not overlap.

**Bottom Card: "Spike & outlier sweep"**
*   **Header Text:** The bold, black text **"Spike & outlier sweep"** is positioned at the top-left.
    *   *Note on the Ampersand:* The "&" symbol is clearly visible between the words "Spike" and "outlier".
*   **Body Text:** Below the header reads: "Remove GPS teleports, then smooth the elevation outliers beside them." in dark gray text.
*   **Spacing:** Like the card above, the header and body text are vertically stacked without overlap.

**Text Below the Cards**
*   **Paragraph:** A block of dark gray text sits below the third card, reading: "Presets use the shipped deep-check settings, tune an individual file in the repair studio. Nothing here touches the originals."

**The "N" Icon (Bottom Left)**
*   **Shape:** A circular button with a solid dark gray or charcoal background.
*   **Content:** Centered within this circle is a white, uppercase, serif letter **"N"**.
*   **Position:** This icon is located in the bottom-left corner of the image frame.
*   **Overlap Analysis:** The circular "N" button visually overlaps the bottom-left corner of the text paragraph ("...originals."). The edge of the dark circle cuts across the bottom of the letters in the final line of text.

**Visual Overlap Summary**
*   **No Overlap:** The text elements within the cards (headers vs. body) do not overlap. The cards themselves are separated by gaps and do not touch.
*   **Overlap Present:** The only significant visual overlap is between the **circular "N" button** and the **final line of text** ("...originals."). The button sits on top of the text layer.
